title: Bento metrics grid

intent.caption: Bento metrics grid — A 2x2 bento of stat tiles with one dominant cell; machined surfaces, engineered gradients, no flat voids.

visualSpec.effects: Bento grid spans 5.5 x 3.5 scene units centered at origin with 0.25-unit gutters (1x base). Dominant cell: 3.25 x 3.5 units occupying the left column, both rows; two secondary cells 2.0 x 1.625 units stacked in the right column. Each cell is a shallow extruded slab 0.06 units deep, surface #14141a with a 135-deg engineered diagonal gradient #101017 to #1a1a22 (hard-stop machined sheen band 0.15 units wide at 40 percent, +6 percent value), edge material brushed metal roughness 0.5, metalness 0.45, clearcoat 0.2 on a 0.04-unit chamfer that catches the key light. Inner padding 0.5 units (card padding token). Each cell carries a #ff2a38 tick bar 0.4 x 0.05 units at emissive 1.3, top-left inside the padding. Dominant cell: value in Lora 600 at 0.62-unit em height with label below at 0.5-unit offset; secondary cells: value at 0.34-unit em height plus label. Grid header caption sits 0.5 units above the grid, left-aligned to the grid edge at x=-2.75. Entrance: stagger-cards, fade-up per cell (opacity 0 to 1, y +0.2 to 0, 500ms, cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94)) at 80ms stagger, dominant first. Hover: press-down scale 1.0 to 0.97 in 120ms cubic-bezier(0.175,0.885,0.32,1.275), release weighted-settle 1.04 to 1.0 over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1). No cell is a flat void: every surface carries the gradient, chamfer light, and tick structure.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Tiles fade up with an 80ms stagger (dominant cell first); hover presses a tile to 0.97 scale and releases with weighted 1.04 overshoot.

contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 labels and caption (#e8ecf2 on #14141a = 15.2:1); 3:1 large display values; accent ticks decorative, accent-as-text would be 5.2:1 on #0b0b10
